::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
**Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models** extend the multimodal transformer into physical control:
the same architecture that reads text and images now outputs robot actions, grounding language
instructions in perception and continuous motor commands.
:::
